input: Find bootstrapped European vertical SaaS companies for logistics or freight with 50-200 employees

output.search_notes: Screened as_of 2026-11-09. One company was verified against the required criteria; this is not an exhaustive market census. Bootstrapping is supported by affirmative historical self-financing statements, paired with a recent family-ownership confirmation—not merely an absence of funding announcements. Headcounts are estimates; observation dates are distinguished from measurement dates. Fargo Systems was excluded as August Equity-backed: the investor announced its investment on 2024-10-02 and its portfolio lists Fargo Group as a current investment (source_urls: http://www.augustequity.com/news-insights/august-equity-announces-investment-in-fargo-systems ; http://www.augustequity.com/portfolio/fargo-group/). missing_fields: {"Riege Software":["last_round"]}. No funding-round record/date or methodologically comparable headcount-growth rate was verified.

companies.headcount_growth: 87 employees as_of 2025-07-01 (source_url: https://craft.co/riege-p-c/human-capital), versus 86 employees as_of 2025-09, attributed to LinkedIn (source_url: https://getlatka.com/companies/riege.com). These are different providers' snapshots; a reliable like-for-like growth rate cannot be established.
companies.rank_reason: Strong fit through explicit self-financing evidence, recent confirmation of family ownership, a European headquarters, a target-range employee estimate, and freight-specific SaaS. Established international customer adoption strengthens the fit. The employee estimate and historical nature of the financing evidence remain diligence caveats.
companies.employees: Approximately 101 LinkedIn-listed employees, observed as_of 2026-11-09; the underlying measurement date is unstated. This is an estimate, not verified payroll headcount. source_url: https://linkedin.com/company/riege
companies.name: Riege Software
companies.traction: Scope serves more than 900 companies, with users in 60 countries, as_of 2026-07-29. source_url: https://www.riege.com/company/press/press-releases/riege-software-names-christian-riege-as-new-ceo

criteria_evidence.evidence: In a release dated 2018-04-04, management stated that every euro came from the company's own resources rather than investors or lenders. This is affirmative historical self-financing evidence.

A company history dated 2025-09-30 states that redevelopment of its freight software was financed from its own funds, without banks or investors. This describes historical product development, not an audited statement of all current financing.
The announcement dated 2026-07-29 says Riege remains in family hands and has been privately held since its founding in 1985.
The company profile lists its website as https://www.riege.com and its address in Meerbusch, NRW, Germany; observed as_of 2026-11-09.

The company's press kit explicitly describes Scope as Software as a Service for freight forwarding. Its announcement dated 2026-07-29 identifies Scope as a cloud-based transport management system for air freight, sea freight and customs.
The opened company profile reports 101 employees, within the required 50–200 range. Observed as_of 2026-11-09; the count's measurement date is not stated and it should be treated as an estimate.
Logistik-Initiative Hamburg lists Riege in its member directory and describes Scope as freight-forwarding software for air freight, sea freight and customs; directory observed as_of 2026-11-09.

basis.reasoning: The primary German releases provide affirmative historical self-financing evidence. The July 2026 announcement establishes continuing family ownership, private status since 1985, the freight-specific cloud product and adoption by more than 900 companies in 60 countries. The press kit explicitly identifies SaaS delivery. The company profile supplies the name, domain, German address and 101-person estimate. Craft and GetLatka provide the two dated historical employee counts; no percentage is calculated because comparability is unverified. The association directory independently corroborates membership and freight-software specialization. Rank is an assessment of fit, not a sourced market ranking. No verified funding-round value is supplied, hence null.
